data.name: Bashir
data.gender_notes: Bashir is used as a male name in islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root ب-ش-ر (b-sh-r), 'to give good news'. Bashīr means 'bringer of good tidings'. Its root is ب-ش-ر (b-sh-r). A Qur'anic term; a common Muslim name. Bashir is a Arabic name meaning “Bringer of good news”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Bashir expresses “Bringer of good news”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Arabic root ب-ش-ر (b-sh-r), 'to give good news'. Bashīr means 'bringer of good tidings'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bashir total 30, reducing to 3. Number 3 is associated with expression, creativity and optimism.
